wave.summary: Contract freeze landed as commit de7ba82 on wave-660758-T-001. shared/contract.js (plain ESM + JSDoc, importable by both the zero-build Node server and Vite): typedefs for RepoSummary (three-state upstream — 'none' can never read as unpushed), Snapshot, AttentionEntry, ScanEvent; ATTENTION_ORDER priority list + attentionComparator/sortAttention (dirty > unpushed > stale, recency descending tie-break); local-TZ dayKey; STALE_DAYS=90 with isStale using STRICT > per the spec domain rule (exactly 90 days is NOT stale — test pins the boundary at 90d=false, 90d+1ms=true); isScanEvent runtime validator; route constants + apiRepoRoute builder + ROUTES bag; CSS render-vocabulary constants + advisoryClass/heatmapLevelClass helpers. shared/fixtures.js: one deterministic canonical Snapshot (6 repos: two dirty for recency tie-break, unpushed aheadBy 3, stale ~203d, clean, no-remote; seeded-PRNG 12-month commitDays via UTC arithmetic, zero wall-clock reads), attention stored pre-sorted. shared/contract.test.js: 37 hand-computed assertions covering every enum value, a scrambled comparator matrix, the dayKey TZ trap (2026-01-02T03:30Z -> '2026-01-01' in Chicago), ScanEvent shape, deep-equal fixture attention lock, and a Plate frame markup lock (mounted via createElement + Testing Library, no JSX needed in the .js test). vite.config.ts pins TZ=America/Chicago via test.env — verified green under ambient TZ=Asia/Tokyo. Lock strength was mutation-verified: 5 seeded drifts (comparator order swap, stale >=, dayKey switched to UTC getters, ScanEvent phase rename, fixture attention reorder) each fail the suite; restored state green. tokens.css: cream/indigo-black themes on [data-theme], vermilion reserved exclusively for attention (advisory--no-remote deliberately ink-only), hairline rules, small-caps serif captions, mono tabular soundings, concrete classes for every vocabulary name incl. heatmap-cell--l0..l4. index.html loads /src/main.tsx (another builder's file, referenced not created) with a pre-paint theme bootstrap. Notes for the conductor: (1) package.json/package-lock/node_modules are UNTRACKED in the shared repo, so worktrees don't inherit them — I symlinked the main repo's node_modules and package.json into my worktree to run npm test (symlinks left untracked, not committed, not in files_changed; future wave builders will hit the same gap); (2) no separate Plate.test.tsx exists because src test files were outside my file scope — the Plate lock lives inside shared/contract.test.js instead; (3) `vite build` will fail until src/main.tsx exists — expected, out of my scope.
